_template: DemoIQ config template - blank reference of the fields in a plain DemoIQ_config.json (the config library <ws>/configs).
_notes: Field shape only; contains no credentials. Configs are plain, owner-only JSON written by the Config Builder (Save config) or scripts/draft_config.ps1 - do not hand-edit one to feed the seeder. adminPwd and existingCertThumbprint stay empty: the administrator signs in for each run and the DemoIQ app has no certificate. existingAppId and speechResourceId come from the deployment receipts (scripts/repoint_config.ps1). The five u<N>upn/u<N>pwd demo users are required; their passwords are typed only in the Builder. scenarioIndex is 1-4 (or null for a custom scenario); scenarioId mirrors the picked scenario's id. aopSurfaces ids: outlook,teams,excel,ppt,word,agents,copilotapp,code,autopilot. aopAgents ids: wxp,facilitator,interpreter,cowork,researcher,analyst. companyName is optional - blank keeps the classic Contoso defaults; a custom scenario's own Company: line wins over it. rossId/opportunityId/tpid are upstream engagement-tracking fields kept only so a config round-trips: this adaptation never asks for, prefills, transmits or uses them in generated content, prompts, file names or the AoP runbook. options.wordDocs/pptDecks/excelWorkbooks are FILE counts (how many separate Word docs / PPT decks / Excel workbooks to seed; default 1, max 5) - the other Word/PPT/Excel counts size the inside of each file.
